maddeler.t: Probably metathetical to original *بُرْدُج (*burduj) and related to the fabric بَرْذَعَة (barḏaʕa, “saddle-pad”), بُرْزُغ (burzuḡ), بُرْزُوغ (burzūḡ), بِرْزَاغ (birzāḡ, “activity, vivacity, alacrity, vivid habit”), بِرْزِيق (birzīq, “a procession of horsemen”), بِرْزِين (birzīn, “drinking-cup made out of a palm-tree branch”).
